rule.unseen: a test entity whose words are no entity of the training sentences (ner_mentions.py)
rule.leaked: a corpus sentence sharing a run of 50 characters without spaces, in lower case, with a sentence of the held-out subfield's documents; left out
rule.exact: the name's words in a row in a remaining sentence, the corpus cut with MuLMS's hyphen rule; names of more than 8 words count as absent
rule.loose: the name without spaces, in lower case, inside a remaining sentence without spaces
